about: Every harness that runs a child with a working directory of its own, and how each file it names for that child stays absolute or relative to that directory. tests/frame.py fails on a harness that sets cwd= and is not listed here, on an entry whose file no longer sets it, on an entry whose evidence line is missing from its file, and, for an entry held by its callers, on any call in ci/check or tests/backend/run-linux that names --out other than from the repository root.

tests/front/record_output_test.py.how: names the writer and its output absolutely, inside a temporary repository

tests/lower/corpus.py.how: runs the differ at the repository root, where its callers' relative paths are rooted

tests/numeric/corpus.py.how: runs the differ at the repository root

tests/numeric/float_cases.py.how: its case table digests this whole file, so every caller names --out absolutely

tests/oracle_readonly.py.how: names its fixture absolutely, inside a temporary directory

tests/strings/corpus.py.how: runs the differ at the repository root

tests/subset/modes.py.how: names the source relative to the child's own folder, the compiler absolutely

tests/types/tranche_corpus.py.how: runs the differ at the repository root

tools/check-subset.how: runs each claim row at the repository root, by its absolute path

tools/differlib.py.how: a library: execute() runs what its callers name, and each caller is listed here
